words.meaning: A friendly and peaceful relationship, understanding, or mutual goodwill between individuals or groups.
words.sentence1: Their long years of collaborative study fostered an enduring bond of amity. (Their long years of collaborative study fostered an enduring bond of amity.)
words.sentence2: The evening gathering was marked by genuine amity and shared laughter among old companions. (The evening gathering was marked by genuine amity and shared laughter among old companions.)

words.meaning: A deep bond of brotherhood, fellowship, and mutual solidarity.
words.sentence1: Entre ellos existe una verdadera hermandad que supera cualquier distancia. (Between them exists a true brotherhood that overcomes any distance.)
words.sentence2: El viaje compartido fortalecio los lazos de hermandad en el grupo. (The shared journey strengthened the bonds of brotherhood within the group.)

words.meaning: Warm social camaraderie, friendliness, and the shared pleasure of connecting together.
words.sentence1: Le diner s'est deroule dans une atmosphere chaleureuse et pleine de convivialite. (The dinner took place in a warm atmosphere full of friendliness.)
words.sentence2: Cette soiree entre collegues a renforce la convivialite et l'esprit d'equipe. (This evening among colleagues strengthened camaraderie and team spirit.)

words.meaning: A close bond of cohesion, solidarity, and mutual loyalty among companions.
words.sentence1: In schwierigen Zeiten beweist der Zusammenhalt der Freunde seine wahre Starke. (In difficult times, the cohesion of friends proves its true strength.)
words.sentence2: Das gemeinsame Projekt hat den Zusammenhalt in unserer Gruppe deutlich vertieft. (The shared project clearly deepened the cohesion in our group.)

words.meaning: A human connection, interpersonal link, or enduring bond of relationship.
words.sentence1: Nan-nen tatte mo, watashitachi no kokoro no tsunagari wa kesshite kienai. (Even after many years, the connection between our hearts never fades.)
words.sentence2: Atarashii deai ga fukai tsunagari e to hatten shimashita. (A new encounter developed into a deep connection.)

words.meaning: Harmonious rapport, mutual understanding, or being in natural emotional sync with another.
words.sentence1: Fin dal primo incontro abbiamo percepito una perfetta sintonia tra noi. (From the very first meeting, we felt a perfect rapport between us.)
words.sentence2: La profonda sintonia tra i due amici rendeva superflue le parole. (The deep mutual understanding between the two friends made words unnecessary.)

words.meaning: An intimate, bosom friend who truly understands one's heart and thoughts.
words.sentence1: Rensheng de yi zhiji, zuxi wei ping sheng. (To find a single true bosom friend in life is enough for a lifetime.)
words.sentence2: Yuanfang de zhiji zong neng mingbai ta xinzhong de ganshou. (The distant bosom friend could always understand the feelings in his heart.)

words.meaning: A uniquely profound emotional bond of warmth, attachment, and compassionate connection.
words.sentence1: Oraen sigan hamkke bonaemyeo seoroege gipeun jeong-i deureotda. (Spending a long time together, a deep bond of affection developed between them.)
words.sentence2: Chingu saie nanuneun ttatteuthan jeong-eun salmeul balge bikchunda. (The warm affection shared between friends illuminates life.)

words.meaning: Solidarity, unity, mutual harmony, and cohesive fellowship among people.
words.sentence1: Samakki rovoang mittapheak thveu aoy puokke chhneah krup oupasak. (Solidarity among friends enabled them to overcome all obstacles.)
words.sentence2: Puokke ban bangeut samakki yang reungmoam knong krom. (They built a very strong bond of solidarity within the group.)

words.meaning: A profound sense of togetherness, solidarity, and mutual belonging among companions.
words.sentence1: Die warm gevoel van saamhorigheid het almal om die vuur verenig. (The warm feeling of togetherness united everyone around the fire.)
words.sentence2: Ware vriende vind krag in hul diep gevoel van saamhorigheid. (True friends find strength in their deep sense of togetherness.)
